courses.subject: PLPA
courses.title: Plants, Pathogens, and People
courses.description: Plant diseases and their impact on food supplies and human history are studied in lectures, demonstrations and discussions. Issues of food production and safety, pesticide use and human health, and the environment are considered. Includes the biology of pathogens that cause plant disease. Designed for non-science and science majors.

courses.subject: PLPA
courses.title: Undergrad Research or Thesis
courses.description: Independent research, special problems, thesis, development and/or design work under the supervision of an appropriate member of the faculty. May be repeated. Independent Study courses are limited to 12 hours total applying to a degree in ACES.
courses.prereqText: Cumulative GPA of 2.5 or above at the time the activity is arranged and consent of instructor.

courses.subject: PLPA
courses.title: Advanced Plant Pathology
courses.description: Provides students with advanced knowledge of major plant pathogens, including fungi, oomycetes, bacteria, nematodes and viruses as well as major diseases they cause in plants. Lecture topics include taxonomy, etiology, pathogenesis, molecular biology, epidemiology and management. The underlying mechanisms associated with pathogenicity and the complex nature of plants and their pathogens will be presented. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours.
courses.prereqText: CPSC 212 or consent of instructors, or graduate student status. Junior standing required.

courses.subject: PLPA
courses.title: Plant Disease Diagnosis & Mgmt
courses.description: Field and laboratory techniques in plant disease diagnosis and appraisal; identification of diseases of small grains, turf, corn, soybeans, forage crops, vegetables, fruit, forest and shade trees, and ornamentals, both on field trips and in laboratory exercises. Includes fundamentals of disease management. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours.
